completion.note: The full checklist has 35 tasks and appears in-game at Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion after the story. These are the items the guides have confirmed so far — the in-game list is the final word.
completion.title: What 100% completion asks for

rules.text: There is no mission replay. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter — it is your only rewind if you miss an optional interaction.
rules.title: Save by hand, every chapter

rules.text: Positive Mental Attitude: one meditation is offered only in Chapter 1 (Lucia's balcony, the morning after Down to Earth). Take it when it appears and keep an early Chapter 1 save.
rules.title: The one missable trophy

rules.text: Turning on a cheat disables trophies and saving for that session. Cheats only unlock after the story anyway — keep them off until the platinum pops.
rules.title: Cheats switch trophies off

rules.text: All 55 are single-player. Nothing on this list depends on a server, another player, or DLC.
rules.title: No online trophies

stages.text: Play the five chapters at your leisure and enjoy it — 12 story trophies unlock as you go, plus the final-mission gold. Take optional missions and stranger strands the moment they appear, scan vehicles and study animals as you travel, and keep manual saves at every chapter boundary. Do the Chapter 1 meditation the morning after Down to Earth: it is the run's only missable trophy.
stages.title: Play the story
warnings: No mission replay: save at every chapter boundary

stages.text: Finish the six character quest lines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) and 8 stranger strands, then sweep the free-roam one-offs: the duo crime trophies, the tank and the airliner, the secret spots. Most of these can be done alongside the story — the earlier you start them, the shorter this stage is.
stages.title: Side strands and free roam
warnings: Five secret trophies have no confirmed trigger at launch — check their guides for the latest leads

stages.text: After the credits, the 100% checklist opens at Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion — work it in order and A Long Road follows. The big items: 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, gold at every shooting range, 250 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans and 500 profile-changing actions. Progress made before the credits already counts.
stages.title: The 100% haul
warnings: Do not push toward the Irredeemable criminal profile — it is permanent
Cards sold at Pawn Shops still count toward your sets

stages.text: Sweep up whatever is left — count trophies a few short of their target, unconfirmed secrets with newly published methods, anything the 100% haul did not cover. When the last one pops, Vice Got a Price! follows immediately.
stages.title: Cleanup and platinum

summary: Four stages, roughly 200 hours at 4/10 difficulty (PowerPyx; Push Square warns it can run past 300). One playthrough is enough, every trophy is single-player, and only one trophy is missable.
title: Roadmap to the platinum
